Person.description: A person: staff, client or contact. A first name alone is not an identity.

Animal.description: A patient animal, independent of who owns or treats it.

CareRole.description:
Who stands in which role toward an animal: its owner, its treating vet or its nurse.
A vet treating an animal does not own it.

Colleague.description: A working relationship between two staff members: one supervises or covers for the other.

Appointment.description: A visit booked for an animal. state says booked, done or cancelled; a wish to book is not a booking.

Task.description: A job someone asked for or took on. requested_by asked for it, assignee does it, recipient receives the result.

Invoice.description: A bill for a visit. paid stays empty until a payment is recorded.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Animal)-[:vet]->(n1:Person) WHERE n0.name = 'Bramble' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Person)-[:pet]->(n1:Animal) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

MATCH (n0:Animal)<-[:animal]-(n1:Invoice) WHERE n0.name = 'Bramble' RETURN n1.paid AS paid

questions.q: Is there a recorded payment for Bramble's invoice?
